# Subpackage Image Relative Path Mis-resolved to Main Package
In WeChat mini-program subpackage pages, writing relative image paths in templates mistakenly resolves them to the main package, causing load failures.

## Problem Root Cause
- Subpackage page templates using relative paths (e.g., /static/images/szf/publishBanner.png) are mis-parsed to main package
- Images fail to load because they are not present in main package static directory

## Fix Approach
- Use same-subpackage import introduction: `import publishBanner from '../static/images/szf/publishBanner.png'`
- Bind imported asset to `:src` in template (reference intention/my.vue)

# TabBar Icons Must Be Imported Locally and Static Paths Corrected
In Su Housing C project, AppTabBar did not import local icons and some pages had wrong static paths, causing icon errors.

## Problem Root Cause
- AppTabBar component did not import local icons
- income/info.vue and maintain/info.vue used wrong image path `./../static` instead of `../static`

## Fix Approach
- Import local icons and mount them to tab pages
- Correct the two files' static path references to `../static`

# Nav-Bar Slot Tab-Line Left Align Causing Tab Not Centered
In Su Housing C project, placing tab-line inside uni-nav-bar slot defaulted to left alignment, not occupying middle area.

## Problem Root Cause
- tab-line placed in uni-nav-bar slot defaults to left alignment
- The middle region was not filled, so Tab was not horizontally centered

## Fix Approach
- Wrap Tab with `message-nav-tabs` component
- Use absolute positioning `left:50%` + `translateX(-50%)` to center horizontally

# Decision Option Records Lack Player Name Needs Detail API
In Su Housing C project, getMaintainResult returns decisionOptionResponseAllList without decisionPlayerName; name exists in detail interface.

## Problem Root Cause
- `getMaintainResult` returned `decisionOptionResponseAllList` options lacking `decisionPlayerName`
- Player name only available via detail interface

## Fix Approach
- In DecisionResult.vue, call `getDecisionRecordDetail` by `decisionResponseId` to fill name and write to voteStore
- DecisionRecord.vue merges cache and interface with field fallback support
- autonomy.js adds `zs-desensitize-flag:0` to prevent desensitization
